phases.title: Qualification contract
acceptance: Record reproducible toolchain, hardware, model, host, sample-rate and block-size matrix
Define measurable latency, timing, overload recovery and soak thresholds
Preserve existing host parameter IDs and verify registered test matrix

phases.title: Model activation and lifecycle reliability
acceptance: Warm up and validate candidates before activation
Reject incompatible rates, metadata, shapes and non-finite output safely
Keep the previous working model after candidate failure
Cover repeated replacement, reset, shutdown and backend failure cases

phases.title: Stable timing, fallback and latency
acceptance: Use a fixed output timeline with consistently aligned dry and wet paths
Report plugin latency accurately
Smooth dry/wet, fallback and recovery transitions
Pass variable-block, impulse-latency, delayed-worker and saturation tests
Expose bounded readiness, latency and overload telemetry

phases.title: Reliable controls, presets and standalone parity
acceptance: Preserve all latent values across prepare and device lifecycle changes
Bound and version state parsing and handle missing/superseded models visibly
Add standalone device selection, MIDI learn and versioned preset recall
Test more than eight latent dimensions through restore and audio processing

phases.title: Real-model and host qualification
acceptance: Benchmark selected real streaming RAVE exports on the target Mac
Complete the agreed soak and overload recovery tests
Validate standalone, VST3 and AU behavior in selected hosts
Repeat full build/test/signature matrix and document measured limitations
